github_actions.workflow: CACE Canonical Qualification + H¹ Closure + Resumable Proof Cache

verified_scope: exact-current-head Lean 4 qualification of the v3.30 continuum proof-strengthening contract across 38 declared theorem endpoints, including loaded-environment theorem metadata, fail-closed kernel axiom audit, content-addressed attestation, independent source-bound verification, and executable source binding
immutability_note: The 40-hex Git commit id is the immutable qualification baseline identifier. The convenience branch is movable and is not itself an immutable release tag. This administrative record lives on main and does not change the qualified commit.
nonclaims: The H1/H(div) regularization criteria do not themselves construct the unconditional regularizers required for reverse graph inclusion.

The H1 distributional-graph converse endpoints establish the representation-level H1 identification only; they do not by themselves construct unconditional H(div) graph density or every concrete PDE trace/core hypothesis.

The audited weak-Green and continuum Prager-Synge endpoints remain conditional on their explicit BoundedGreenPairing, GreenSmoothCore, zero-boundary-trace, and cross-term-identification hypotheses; this baseline does not construct every concrete PDE instance.
CACE does not establish external reproducer/reviewer identity or independence; those remain external trust boundaries.

The executable binding certifies theorem-endpoint membership and qualified proof provenance only; it does not establish that runtime PDE inputs satisfy theorem hypotheses or that arbitrary numerical outputs are formally verified.
The hasZeroBoundaryTrace_zero endpoint discharges only the exact zero test field; it does not certify arbitrary nonzero runtime fields, sampled boundary values, or finite-element traces.
This formal qualification is not by itself a claim that the entire CACE application is production-ready.
